title: Peptic Ulcer Disease
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Refers to acid related peptic ulceration involving the lower esophagus; stomach and duodenum as a result of active inflammation induced by acid –pepsin leading to disruption of the mucosal integrity causing local defect or excavation
